Object.Name: Periodic Sensor Sampler
Object.Description1: The autosen Periodic Sensor Sampler object can be used to sample one or more sensor value(s) at periodic intervals

Item.Name: Sensor Value Path
Item.Description:
Resources are specified using Core Link syntax
Example:
Instance #0: </3303/0/5700>
Instance #1: </3303/1/5700>

Item.Name: Sampling Start Time
Item.Description: Specifies the number of seconds after midnight UTC from which the sampler should be started

Item.Name: Sampling Interval
Item.Description: Specifies the Interval at which the sampling is to be repeated from the Sampling Start Time.

Item.Name: Sampling Count
Item.Description: Specifies the number of intervals to be performed in the sampling interval, starting from the Sampling Start Time

Item.Name: Step Filter
Item.Description: Only when the value pointed by LwM2M resource Sensor Value Path changes by more than Step Filter the Sampler should evaluate the value

Item.Name: Sampling Days of the Week
Item.Description: Specifies the days of the week when sampling should occur. The value is a single byte (bitmask), where Bit 0 = Sunday, Bit 1 = Monday, ..., Bit 6 = Saturday

Item.Name: Sampling Recurrence
Item.Description:
Specifies the Recurrence in days in which the Sampler will be executed. This works in combination with "Sampling Days of the Week" (ID 5),  
        allowing finer control over when sampling occurs.
